user.title: Connect to the Siemens OZW672
user.description: Enter the connection details of the OZW672 web server.

device.title: Select the plant device
device.description: The OZW672 reports the devices it is wired to. Select the controller to use. Datapoint identifiers are generated for the plant, so the selection identifies this installation in Home Assistant.

datapoints.title: Datapoints of your installation
datapoints.description:
A datapoint is identified by its topic in the controller and not by its numeric identifier: the OZW672 generates the identifiers for the plant it is wired to, and they change when the plant or the server parameters are refreshed. The identifier is checked again on every reload.

Add the datapoints you want to use, then finish.

add_datapoints.title: Add datapoints
add_datapoints.description: Choose the topic of the controller to browse. The datapoints are grouped by topic, exactly as in the menu tree of the OZW672.

pick.title: Select the datapoints
pick.description: Select the datapoints of this topic to add. Writable numeric datapoints become numbers, the others become sensors; the entity type can be changed afterwards in the options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the OZW672
reauth_confirm.description: The OZW672 rejected the stored credentials. Update them below.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the OZW672.
error.no_datapoints: No datapoint was found on this device. Check that the OZW672 is wired to a controller and that the plant is online.

settings.title: Polling settings
settings.description: How often the OZW672 datapoints are read.

add_datapoints.title: Add datapoints
add_datapoints.description: Choose the topic of the controller to browse. The datapoints are grouped by topic, exactly as in the menu tree of the OZW672.

pick.title: Select the datapoints
pick.description: Select the datapoints of this topic to add. Writable numeric datapoints become numbers, the others become sensors; the entity type can be changed afterwards with 'Edit a datapoint'.

error.cannot_connect: The OZW672 menu tree could not be read.

abort.no_datapoints: No datapoint is configured for this installation yet.

write_datapoint.name: Write datapoint
write_datapoint.description: Write a value to an arbitrary datapoint of a Siemens OZW672 device.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Target OZW672 config entry. Optional when only one is configured.

datapoint_id.name: Datapoint id
datapoint_id.description: Numeric identifier of the datapoint in the OZW672 menutree.

value_type.name: Value type
value_type.description: OZW672 datapoint type. Use Enumeration for switch-like datapoints.
